evidence.speaker: contact
evidence.quote: I already told you, please stop calling, I don't want this.
evidence.rationale: Contact firmly declined, contradicting an 'Interested' disposition.

evidence.speaker: agent

reasoning_summary: The call is dispositioned Interested, but the contact firmly declined and asked the agent to stop calling. Not Interested is the accurate disposition.
